title: rasbt/LLMs-from-scratch: build a language model step by step in PyTorch
friendlyTitle: Learn how a language model works by building one yourself
summary: LLMs-from-scratch is a practical code companion that implements a GPT-style language model in PyTorch without relying on external LLM libraries. It walks through core architecture, pretraining and fine-tuning concepts in inspectable stages.
friendlySummary: This popular learning project shows how to create a small GPT-style model step by step with PyTorch.
whyItMatters: Developers and technical leaders can use the repository to understand what model libraries normally hide, making architecture and training discussions more concrete. It is an educational path rather than a shortcut to training a competitive frontier model.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to understand the parts inside an LLM instead of treating the model as a black box. It is for learning, not for cheaply building a frontier model.
